SELECT f.week_ending_date,
 count(*) n,
 count(distinct (s.store_id, p.sku)) dist_store_sku,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.closing_value - f.closing_units*p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.week_ending_date NOT BETWEEN s.valid_from AND s.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) store_ver_bad,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.week_ending_date NOT BETWEEN p.valid_from AND p.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) prod_ver_bad,
 sum(CASE WHEN p.delisted_on IS NOT NULL AND p.delisted_on < f.week_ending_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) after_delist,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.closing_units=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zero_units,
 max(f.closing_units) max_units,
 sum(f.closing_value) val_all,
 sum(f.closing_units*p.standard_unit_cost) val_recalc
FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key)
WHERE p.category='Paint & Decorating' AND f.week_ending_date BETWEEN '2026-06-29' AND '2026-08-02'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT f.week_ending_date, sum(f.closing_value) AS chain_stock_value
  FROM fact_stock_week f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.week_ending_date
  WHERE p.category = 'Paint & Decorating' AND s.store_id < 900
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
  GROUP BY f.week_ending_date)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, 'Paint & Decorating' AS category, count(*) AS n_weeks, round(avg(chain_stock_value), 2) AS avg_stock_value_at_cost_eur FROM weekly
